AgentWorkloadAvailabilityWorkforceContro.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.agent_service_profile (new), marketing.agent_availability, marketing.case, marketing.conversation, marketing.service_queue (new) and workforce.shift
AgentWorkloadAvailabilityWorkforceContro.description: One agent's live status and workload. Rates are over the period since the agent's current shift started, or the venue's current day when no shift is rostered.

slaRiskCases.description: The agent's open cases at risk or breached.

utilization.description: Active cases and conversations over `maxConcurrentCases`; above 1 means overloaded.

id.description: Created on the device (`CreateCaseRequest.id`, `raiseMyCase`), so a UUIDv7.

caseNumber.description: **Server-assigned: the venue prefix plus a sequence per venue** (decided 28 September, audit R152). Not gapless; only tax invoices are gapless, per legal entity. Assigned when the case reaches the server, so a retry with the same `id` keeps its number.

guestName.description: **Resolved from `pii.subject` when the case is read, never stored on the case.** A name copied onto a case row is personal data outside the erasable store (ADR-0023), and it had no source anyway — no request carries it. Returned only to callers holding `GUEST_VIEW_PII`, as `searchGuests` does.

subject.description: **The case's one-line title**, not a person. Stored as `title` so the table does not hold `subject` beside `subject_id`; the wire keeps `subject` because screens bind it.

kind.description: What the guest said it was about, where the guest raised it.

channel.description: How the guest reached the venue — `CreateCaseRequest.channel`, or `inApp` for a case raised through `raiseMyCase`.

recordedAt.description: Device time the case was raised — the start of the SLA clock.

syncedAt.description: Server time the case arrived. Equal to `recordedAt` for a case raised online.

queueId.description: The `ServiceQueue` the case waits in, set by routing (`CaseRoutingRule.queueId`). Null once routed straight to an agent. (decided 29 September, data model for the agreed operations)

membershipId.description: The identity membership this case concerns (`identity.customer_membership`); member case notes are cases with this set. (decided 29 September, coordinator decision DM4, writers pass)

isSlaBreached.description: **Computed when read, never stored.** True once the case has been open longer than its SLA allows — the time from `recordedAt` to `resolvedAt` (or to now, while unresolved), less `slaPausedSeconds`, is past the target that set `slaDueAt`. A stored flag would need a job to flip it at the moment of breach, and no such job is designed; `listCases?breachedSla` filters on the same computation.

slaPausedSeconds.description: Accrued only while awaiting the guest. Waiting on an internal team does not pause the clock.

CaseCategory.description: **The venue's case taxonomy**: categories and, under them, subcategories (`parentCategoryId`). `Case.categoryId` and the routing rules' `match.categoryIds` point here; `createCaseClassificationIntelligent` recommends one. Maintained by `setCaseCategoryDefinition`, read by `listCaseCategories` (decided 29 September, writers pass). (decided 29 September, data model for the agreed operations)

parentCategoryId.description: Set on a subcategory; null on a top-level category.

defaultPriority.description: The priority a case in this category starts at before routing factors apply.

CaseKind.description:
**What the guest says the case is about**, in their words rather than the venue's taxonomy — `raiseMyCase` asks for it and `categoryId` is what staff file it under. Stored on the case, because a lost-property report that forgets it was one cannot be routed to the lost and found desk.
**`other` only with a note (decided 28 September, audit R222).** A case raised as `other` must carry a non-empty `detail` (`raiseMyCase`), or it is refused with 400; the notes are reviewed quarterly to add the real kinds they reveal.

resolution.description: **What was actually done about it.** Indexed for retrieval: an agent facing a complaint benefits more from how the last one was resolved than from a policy. Without this column `marketing.case` can only embed its subject line.

membershipId.description: The identity membership this case concerns (`identity.customer_membership`); member case notes are cases with this set. Must belong to `subjectId` when both are given (422). (decided 29 September, coordinator decision DM4, writers pass)

attachmentRefs.description: Stored on the opening `CaseMessage`, not on the case.

recordedAt.description: Device time the case was raised. The server stamps `Case.syncedAt` on arrival.

EscalationCriticalCaseMonitorView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.case, marketing.case_escalation (new, one row per escalateCase call) and the related order in orders
EscalationCriticalCaseMonitorView.description: One open escalated case, as of its latest escalation.

customerName.description: Resolved from `pii.subject`; null unless the caller holds `GUEST_VIEW_PII`.

reason.description: The reason given to `escalateCase`, or `SLA breached` for an automatic escalation.

escalationType.description: `vip` for a VIP-tier customer, `financial` for a refund or high-value order, `eventDay` when the case's event is today, `management` when escalated to a manager, `technical` for a technical category; the first that applies, in that order.

transactionValue.description: The related order's total, when the case has one.

MarketingSlaPolicy.description: **Taken from the backend workbook, 20 September.** Defines service-level response and resolution targets used by support cases.

ServiceQueue.description: **A customer-service queue** (e.g. `eventDaySupport`). Cases (`Case.queueId`), routing rules (`queueId`, `fallbackQueueId`) and agents (`AgentAvailability.queueIds`) name it; `listContact` and `listAgentWorkloadAvailability` report per queue. Maintained by `setServiceQueueDefinition`, read by `listServiceQueues` (decided 29 September, writers pass). (decided 29 September, data model for the agreed operations)

overflowWaitSeconds.description: The queue's overflow threshold; a case waiting longer marks the queue `critical`.

SlaPolicyServiceLevelManagementView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.case and marketing.sla_policy
SlaPolicyServiceLevelManagementView.description: SLA performance for the filters given. Counts are of open cases for the state counts and of cases in the period for the averages and the compliance rate.

averageResponseSeconds.description: Mean time to first response, less paused time.

slaComplianceRate.description: Cases resolved in the period within target, over cases resolved in the period.

byPolicy.description: One row per SLA policy that timed a case in the period, worst compliance first.

forecastBreaches.description: AI forecast of open cases likely to breach before the static thresholds fire, soonest first. Advisory; empty when AI is disabled for the tenant.
